source_request: Make a photorealistic image of an adult handling the sky itself like a flexible sheet.
interpreted_intent: The sky itself is tangible and flexible enough for an adult to handle
subject: An adult physically handling the sky itself
setting: A broad rooftop terrace beneath blue sky, chosen for this baseline only
event: An adult physically handles a continuous region of sky as a flexible sheet
visual_priorities: Keep the handled region identifiable as the sky itself and continuous with its surrounding region
Make the adult's hand contact and anatomically plausible support visible
Use a readable material response and depth without locking a particular fold design
baseline_prompt_en: A full-body photograph shows an adult and the sky itself. The sky becomes a flexible sheet; the adult physically handles the sky. On a broad rooftop terrace, the person supports a lowered blue fold across two open palms. Both feet are planted apart on level paving, knees soft, with hips centered between the feet. Each visible forearm leads to its own upward-facing palm at waist height; elbows stay bent beside the torso and fingers cup the fold from beneath. One continuous band descends from the sky above, its upper attachment and curved edges visible. Cloud streaks follow the fold; underside shadow reveals thickness. A front three-quarter view leaves face, limbs, hands, feet, and gaps between neighboring fingers unobstructed in afternoon light.
